mappings.visualRationale: Visibly shows a radiant golden aegis with a central blue jewel deflecting and reflecting incoming rays of hostile magical energy, matching Rathgamnon's golden abjurative ward to end hostile magical effects.
Visibly shows an overwhelming, blinding golden-orange solar beam striking down from above, capturing the devastating high-tier 5d8 radiant unmaking ray at far range.

Visibly shows a flayed humanoid figure arched backward in torment as wisps of glowing purple soul and spell essence are siphoned from their chest, matching Mordanticus the Flayed and the spell-draining effect.
Visibly shows a humanoid figure doubled backward in acute bodily agony with jagged orange-red pain bursts radiating from their spine, depicting severe direct torment (3d8 damage).
Visibly shows a solid, gleaming golden anchor glowing against a dark background, directly representing Rathgamnon anchoring and binding targets with golden runic magic.
Visibly shows an ornate golden longsword backed by angelic wings and radiant white rays of holy light, clearly portraying a weapon blessed and consecrated into a +2 magical version.
Visibly shows a midnight shield emblazoned with a glowing triangular arcane rune and surrounded by a radiant blue warding aura, embodying a Mage's protective AC 16 force shield.
Visibly shows a humanoid silhouette pulled upward along a light beam into an open swirling violet planar rift, capturing extradimensional creatures being cast out and returned to their home planes.
Visibly shows a humanoid hand and arm encased in thick, striated brown living tree bark bearing a glowing druidic eye, capturing the natural bark armor transformation.
Visibly shows a wide-open eye with a swirling purple spiral pupil emitting hypnotic waves, directly depicting the stupefying and mesmerizing focus charm.
Visibly shows a humanoid figure immobilized and constricted by swirling magenta energy bands around their body, cleanly illustrating humanoid paralysis.
Visibly shows a concentrated, luminous cyan-blue arcane projectile hurtling forward with a sparkling energy trail, representing a focused single-target 2d6 damage missile.
Visibly shows a bloated insect parasite glowing with a sinister violet cross and dark mystic aura, perfectly evoking a shamanic bug hex that reduces target INT to 1.

Visibly shows an incoming hostile magical beam striking an arcane energy barrier and shattering in a fountain of deflected cyan-blue energy shards, depicting a Mage casting Cancel to dissipate and end an active spell.

Visibly shows an outstretched primal hand summoning a bright leaf-shaped living flame hovering above the palm against a dark backdrop, capturing a Druid conjuring magical fire to strike a distant target.
Visibly shows an agonizing spectral skull engulfed in virulent green flames hurtling forward as a high-speed lethal projectile bolt, capturing an Archmage casting a devastating instant-death spell.

Visibly shows an outstretched bony skeletal hand clawing forward amidst swirling plumes of toxic green necromantic flame, directly illustrating a Cultist channeling deadly necrotic power into a close-quarters touch attack.
Visibly shows an intense vortex of swirling violet hypnotic energy radiating mental distortion waves, portraying an Archmage focusing an enervating psionic field to leave the target stupefied.
Visibly shows a masked shadowy visage cloaked in deep violet night with glowing white eyes receding into obscurity, portraying an Oni fading into the shadows to become invisible.

Visibly shows a massive radial firestorm explosion detonating outward with blinding white-hot incandescent shockwaves and flying embers, capturing an Archmage unleashing a high-tier blast filling an entire near-sized cube.
Glowing azure winged sigil centered within an arcane circular runic transmutation ring with radiant light beams, clearly conveying a magical flight buff.
Luminous translucent blue buoyant spheres floating upwards in an airy atmosphere with soft highlights, capturing gentle weightlessness and floating levitation.
Stacks of plain, unminted imitation gold coins resting on a wooden surface, perfectly depicting manufactured or illusory fake gold.
Swirling planar vortex glowing in brilliant orange and gold opening into a dark portal void with energetic tendrils stretching inward, depicting an interdimensional gateway.
Open palm reaching upward beneath a radiant golden heart surrounded by glowing verdant and golden restorative light rays, depicting healing energy channeled through the hand.
Explosive frost nova erupting outward from a swirling freezing vortex, blasting shards of glacial ice and radiant sub-zero light beams in all directions.
Visibly shows an aggressive serpent with an open hissing maw and bared fangs against green mystical energy rings, fitting a Viperian Wizard hissing to dispel magic.
Visibly shows a black bladed weapon engulfed in bright, sacred golden-orange magical flames within an incantation ring of glowing runes, fitting weapons igniting in magic flames.
Visibly shows a staring eye radiating purple psychic waves with a hypnotic spiral swirl in place of its pupil, matching the naga's stupefying gaze.
Visibly shows a central purple face with glowing phantom duplicates and decoy copies branching out, capturing convincing visual phantasms and illusions.
Visibly shows a wooden druidic branch staff topped with a brilliant glowing green gem/leaf blooming with magical power, fitting a staff imbued into a +3 magic weapon.
Visibly shows a cloaked silhouette fading into deep violet darkness and shadow with only faint glowing cyan eyes, illustrating turning invisible and vanishing from view.
Visibly shows a golden humanoid silhouette floating upwards along swirling vertical ribbons and updrafts of luminous teal magical energy, matching vertical hover and levitation.
Visibly shows a glowing blue arcane energy orb projectile streaking forward with sparkling particles and magical smoke trails, capturing an apprentice's single-target damage bolt.
Visibly shows an ethereal, serpentine ribbon of dense pale white vapor gliding through dark air, matching a creature transmuting into flying mist.
Visibly shows an outstretched arm and hand undergoing transmutation where flesh hardens into interlocking protective armor plates, fitting skin hardening to AC 18.
Visibly shows an incoming hostile spell bolt impacting an impenetrable dark dome ward and shattering into deflected sparks, fitting a nullification aura resisting hostile spells.
Visibly shows a calm face with closed eyes and a glowing crimson third eye opened on the brow radiating prophetic aura, fitting divination and foreseeing advantageous omens.
Visibly shows a glowing pink humanoid dematerializing into particle light while being drawn into an open dimensional vortex portal, matching long-distance self-teleportation.

A glowing celestial blue crystal scrying orb emblazoned with a prominent all-seeing eye and smaller orbiting divination eyes, perfectly visualizing peering into fate and destiny to foretell portents and alter outcomes.

A golden holy shield bearing an emblazoned central cross and framed by outspread white angelic wings with radiant divine light, vividly capturing a priest sacred barrier rebuking and repelling chaotic creatures.
A glowing golden-yellow question mark glyph deeply etched into an ancient cracked stone slab, embodying an enigmatic Sphinx riddle and profound mystery that stupefies the mind.
A curved chitinous brown scorpion tail with a sharp barb dripping glowing lime-green venom against a luminous burst, directly matching a toxic scorpion tail strike.
A glowing purple humanoid silhouette leaping upward through dark space into a swirling planar portal rift, perfectly representing stepping through shadows to teleport across immense distances.
A sinister black death glyph surrounded by a pulsating violet-magenta necromantic aura, capturing an ominous Lich doom sigil capable of dropping mortals straight to 0 HP.
Jointed, spiny brown insect legs with gripping claws set against a dark void, illustrating the physical manifestation of arachnid limbs allowing the caster to skitter and spider-climb.
An intricate interwoven grid of glowing cyan energy ropes and restraining mesh against a purple backdrop, depicting an arcane paralyzing snare that entraps humanoid targets.
A wax candle with melted drippings and a blackened, charred extinguished wick curling at top without a flame, clearly conveying snuffed-out and extinguished light.
A striped crimson arachnid aggressively crawling across a glowing purple web lattice with radiating ethereal strands, capturing a summoned crawling spider swarm.
A spherical bomb bursting open and discharging dense billowing streams of noxious yellowish-green toxic gas, representing a thrown explosive emitting a foul stench cloud.
A ferocious brown bear head roaring with bared fangs against a radiant emerald nature burst, capturing the wild power of a loyal summoned brown bear.
A coiled green and yellow hooded serpent striking forward with wide-open jaws, sharp fangs, and forked tongue amidst swirling green venom vapors, depicting summoned cobras.
Visibly portrays a large, predatory red-and-black spider actively crawling across a glowing violet web with conjuration wisps, perfectly conveying a drow priestess conjuring giant loyal spiders.

Visibly shows a central concussive detonation emitting violent, intersecting shockwave rings and pressure lines blasting outwards in all directions, matching a powerful sonic wave throwing nearby creatures back.

Visibly displays a golden clock dial with rapidly spinning, blurring hands surrounded by warping magenta temporal energy streaks, depicting the localized bending and distortion of time to freeze a target.
Visibly features a stark glowing white stopwatch frozen in place amid static floating motes on a deep blue stasis background, capturing the complete halting and suspension of universal time.

Visibly shows an unfurled parchment scroll bearing an all-seeing occult eye above inscribed runic characters and letters, cleanly illustrating the revelation and deciphering of a target creature's hidden True Name.

Visibly depicts the silhouette of a humanoid body dissolving and disintegrating into crumbling fragments and ash amidst a radiant purple aura, capturing the complete unmaking and destruction of matter.

Visibly shows an aggressive green serpent striking with open jaws, prominent white venom-dripping fangs, and a red tongue against toxic green plumes, directly matching a Viperian wizard casting venomous ranged damage.
Visibly portrays a luminous humanoid silhouette leaping across the empty dark void into a swirling violet interdimensional portal, perfectly representing long-distance planar/astral teleportation.
Visibly illustrates an outstretched purple hand firmly entangled and trapped across a spreading web of thick white spider silk, directly matching the immobilizing restraint of the Web spell.
Visibly depicts a shadowy face with smiling dark purple lips whispering insidious suggestions in the dark, capturing the deceptive murmurs and lowered spell resistance caused by a naga's whispers.
Visibly displays an emaciated, desiccated grey withered hand with claw-like fingers emerging from the darkness, epitomizing the life-draining necrotic rot and decay radiated by a lich.
